latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Simple Video Generator Cartoon — Generate Cartoon Videos from Text."
- Generate animated cartoon videos from text prompts or images, supporting JPG, PNG, MP4, and GIF files up to 200MB.
- No installation required; videos are processed cloud-side and returned in 1080p MP4 format within 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup with anonymous token support; session management handled transparently.
- Includes workflows for export, credit checks, file upload, and timeline previews via simple user prompts.
- Designed for educators, content creators, and parents seeking to turn ideas into cartoon videos quickly and easily.
